title: capri holdings / cplo resignation / corporate governance | Unknown | Capri Holdings Ltd 8-K Filing — Departure of Chief Legal and...
summary: Capri Holdings Ltd filed an 8-K on April 9, 2026 disclosing that Krista McDonough, Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, voluntarily resigned effective June 26, 2026 to pursue another opportunity. The company has initiated a search for her successor.
